verdict.rationale: NotebookLM's documented capability is grounded Q&A, summarization, and format transformation (audio/video overviews, study guides, mind maps) over sources the user manually supplies — all single-pass or one-shot generations rather than an autonomous multi-step investigative process. No evidence shows planning, iterative sub-question decomposition, or self-directed research; in fact a community report explicitly notes it cannot autonomously search for and incorporate new sources into research (notebooklm-comm-4).
